description: Record the user's verdict on a clip: rating good or bad, with an optional reason in their words. Same signal as the thumbs up/down on the Katto results page; it is used to improve which moments Katto picks. Only rate when the user expressed an opinion, never on your own. Rating again records the new verdict (the latest one counts). Returns { ok, clip_index, rating }.

rating.description: The user's verdict on the clip.

reason.description: Optional: why, in the user's words (max 2000 characters).

name: katto_rate_clip
